verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance/SRE Agent and Intelligent Alert Grouping show AI agents handling incidents, summarizing information, and reducing noise via ML, suggesting some proactive AI investigation, but there is no explicit documentation that the AI correlates code/config changes, telemetry, and similar past incidents to surface a probable root cause autonomously before a human asks. missing for 10: explicit description of automated root-cause correlation across changes/telemetry/historical incidents, and independent verification that this happens proactively without human prompting.
